info.title: Catholic Tanzania Core API
info.description: Authoritative Catholic organizational and community master data. Swahili names are primary. Public reads expose verified directory data; private and administrative routes require scoped Sanctum bearer tokens. Codes are globally unique per entity. Standard responses include success/data/meta or success/error. Public limits: 60/minute/IP; authenticated: 120/minute/user. All API responses include X-Request-ID. No destructive deletes.

get.description: Private results are limited to the administrator scope. Public results include active, verified records with active, verified primary ancestors.

put.description: PUT and PATCH both perform partial updates. Set status to inactive or suppressed to retire records. Material changes reset verification. Destructive DELETE is not supported.

get.description: Maximum 100 records per organization type. meta contains totals, truncation flags and paginated URLs. Family/member information is never included.

post.description: Five attempts per minute per IP/email and twenty per IP. No public registration. Tokens expire after eight hours by default.
Requires write permission over both the parish and destination deanery. Transactionally preserves old and new deanery/diocese and resets verification.

Supply full normalized records using existing parent IDs, without status or verification fields. Trims strings and uppercases codes. Does not modify directory records. Returns per-row validation reports; identical batches return the same ID.
Revalidates and atomically upserts by globally unique code. Repeated commits have no effect. Imported records require individual verification before becoming public.

effective_date.description: Today or earlier, and not before the most recent transfer.
